}}'''Rajar''' is the First-Lieutenant in the [[Younglings]] and is from [[Arad Doman]].

== Appearance ==
He has a deep voice and a slight build. He is shorter than [[Gawyn Trakand]].

== Activities ==
He has trained in [[Tar Valon]] for six years.
He is sent a message by Gawyn to prepare for attack from the [[Shaido]] just before the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].

After the battle he fled with the rest of the surviving Younglings to [[Dorlan]] where they waited for word from the [[White Tower]]. He reported to Gawyn about [[Narenwin Barda]] arriving in Dorlan.{{ref/book|10|p}}

He helps Gawyn raid the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] army camped outside of [[Tar Valon]]. When Gawyn goes to leave Dorlan, Rajar doesn't realize this and moves to follow Gawyn. He is told to remain behind.
